paper: Zombie Agents: Persistent Control of Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Self-Reinforcing Injections
code_repository: not released as of this vendoring (2026-09-13); no repo linked in the paper

trigger_dataset.paper_citation: data-for-agents/insta-150k-v1 -- "real-world web interaction queries (e.g., 'Find the latest price of X')" (Section 4.1)
trigger_dataset.fetched_via: HuggingFace datasets-server rows API (https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows), offsets 0 and 100, 100 rows each
trigger_dataset.note: Vendored as-is, no modification. This is genuinely the paper's cited dataset -- confirmed real via HF's dataset API metadata (features: domain, task; arXiv 2502.06776 'InSTA: Towards Internet-Scale Training For Agents').

bait_tasks.status: NOT a named public dataset in the paper -- Section 4.1: "we curate a set of Bait Tasks designed to compel the agent to visit the malicious environment". The paper does not publish this set. bait_tasks.json here is OUR reconstruction, designed to match the described purpose (a benign task that plausibly leads the agent to browse an attacker-controlled page), not a paper-verbatim artifact.

filler_pool.source: huggingface.co/datasets/data-for-agents/insta-150k-v1, same real dataset as the trigger queries
filler_pool.purpose: Pre-seeds the RAG memory database to approximate the paper's 'long-term memory pollution' scale -- Section 4.1: "we utilize a database of 3,000 entries". The paper does not say what the other ~2,997 non-payload entries actually contain, so this is OUR reconstruction of their CONTENT, but not of their SOURCE: rather than synthesize filler text, we use the rest of the paper's own real, cited dataset.
filler_pool.row_range: offsets 200-2934 (the remainder of the 2,935-row test split after the 200 rows already vendored as trigger queries)
filler_pool.note: Combined with the 200 trigger-query rows, this is the ENTIRE real insta-150k-v1 test split (2,935 rows total) -- landing almost exactly on the paper's stated ~3,000-entry database scale, entirely from real data, no synthetic filler.
